reward_strategy.intent: Enemy defeat requests the enemy's eligible unowned soul as a real pickup; collection adds persistent inventory and stops the guarantee for later defeats.
reward_strategy.state_policy: Read existing owned count, retain defeat once-bit and original save inventory; no new state. Until collection, further eligible defeated entities may also request a pickup.
reward_strategy.eligibility: Eleven source-reviewed ordinary species0..10 admitted by the pinned native callback/reward-path certificate, including nine active-soul providers. Original normal-mode/character, once-only and inventory-capacity guards remain. Other species, including boss/scripted and unreviewed encounters, retain original policy.

rules: Hold exactly one horizontal direction while Up+attack successfully casts the Winged Skeleton soul: on real bone birth after native MP debit and partner allocation, commit directional 3px/frame lunge and 1.5px/frame upward velocity; original Soma caster remains intact.
Starter bone inherits half caster horizontal velocity, clamped to 4px/frame contribution; original terrain/contact/retirement remain.
At an ordinary enemy defeat while player horizontal speed >=1px/frame, refund4MP capped at real maxMP; source-certified first unowned souls spawn as actual pickups.
Every3 distinct owned active early souls advances tier up to2: lunge speed +0.5px/frame per tier; moving-defeat refund +2MP per tier. Native collection/save own progression.
limits: Moving is sampled at defeat callback, not last-hit attribution.
No grounded-state assumption or guaranteed new-route claim.
Original controller consumes velocity next tick; native trajectory fixtures and model traversal are separate evidence.
Lunge and projectile momentum are Winged-Skeleton-soul specific; the previous generic cast hook belongs alternate character and does not establish ordinary Soma reachability.

test_fixture.purpose: Explicit integration fixture; not a naturally discovered defect
test_fixture.measurement: Read-only native successful Winged Skeleton birth impulse, not endpoint animation or model assertion
